name: acta/http
description: Contract-first HTTP adapter for PHP 8.5+: an OpenAPI 3.1 contract drives routing, security, request and response validation, with RFC 9457 errors, on PSR-7, PSR-15 and PSR-17.

suggest.acta/event-sourcing: Enables the bridge in Acta\Http\EventSourcing: messages built from validated input, metadata, If-Match, error mapping.
suggest.ext-pdo_pgsql: Required by the PostgreSQL idempotency store.
suggest.ext-yaml: Reads YAML contracts, as an alternative to symfony/yaml.
suggest.phpunit/phpunit: Required to reuse the contract assertions shipped in Acta\Http\Testing.
suggest.symfony/yaml: Reads YAML contracts. Not needed at runtime once the contract is compiled to PHP.

scripts-descriptions.check: Runs the coding standard, static analysis and the whole test suite.
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Runs the tests that do not need a PostgreSQL server.
scripts-descriptions.stan: Analyses the library at the max level, then the tests.
